diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig` lists `:module.eks` in its explicit `depends_on`, but its `local-exec` command already interpolates `module.eks.cluster_name`, so the dependency is already established implicitly by that attribute reference and the explicit entry adds nothing.

`:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` explicitly `depends_on` `:module.eks`, but its `triggers` already reference `module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id` / `module.eks.cluster_security_group_id`, so the ordering is already implied by attribute references.

`:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` explicitly `depends_on` `:module.karpenter`, but the resource already references `module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn` (in `triggers` and in the rendered manifest), which establishes the same dependency implicitly.

`:resource.helm_release.karpenter` explicitly `depends_on` `:module.karpenter`, but its `values` already interpolate `module.karpenter.service_account` and `module.karpenter.queue_name`, so the dependency is established implicitly.

`:resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset` removes the AWS VPC CNI `aws-node` DaemonSet, which must only happen once Calico has been installed and is providing pod networking. It currently depends only on `null_resource.update_kubeconfig`/`module.eks`, so nothing orders it after `:resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation`; Terraform may delete `aws-node` before the Calico `Installation` exists, leaving the cluster without a working CNI. Add an explicit `depends_on = [null_resource.create_calico_installation]` (there is no clean attribute reference on a `null_resource` to express this).
